name: io.github.apitier/mcp-server
description: UK and global agent tools for KYC onboarding, address verification, business validation, EU/UK VAT compliance, and identity checks.

environmentVariables.name: APITIER_MCP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Unified APITier MCP Key — resolves all subscribed service keys automatically. Recommended over individual service keys. Get yours at apitier.com → Account → AI & MCP.

environmentVariables.name: APITIER_POSTCODE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from your APITier UK Postcode subscription — enables verify_uk_address, lookup_uprn, lookup_uk_postcode

environmentVariables.name: APITIER_LEAD_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from your APITier Lead Agent subscription — enables verify_uk_company, get_company_psc

environmentVariables.name: APITIER_VAT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from your APITier VAT Validation subscription — enables validate_vat (UK + EU VIES)

environmentVariables.name: APITIER_EMAIL_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from your APITier Email Validation subscription — enables validate_email

environmentVariables.name: APITIER_PHONE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from your APITier Phone Validation subscription — enables validate_phone

environmentVariables.name: APITIER_PINCODE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from your APITier India Pincode subscription — enables lookup_india_pincode

environmentVariables.name: APITIER_BARCODE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from your APITier Barcode & QR Code subscription — enables generate_barcode, generate_qrcode

environmentVariables.name: APITIER_CONVERT_DATA_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from your APITier Data Conversion subscription — enables convert_data
